title: Fixed sign-shell mass forces a cutoff-independent quartic defect gap

spectral_gap.hypothesis: On normalized T3 let f_N be real with Fourier support |k|_2<=N, s_N=sgn(f_N), delta_N=int(f_N^2-1)^2 and H_(alpha,N)(s_N)>=eta for fixed alpha,eta>0
spectral_gap.gradient_floor: Plancherel on the shell gives ||grad f_N||_2^2>=alpha^2 eta N^2/4
spectral_gap.transition_set: For B_N={|f_N|<1/2}, mu(B_N)<=16delta_N/9 and the K1549 quartic identity gives ||f_N||_4^2<=1+sqrt(delta_N)
spectral_gap.outer_gradient: With g_N=f_N^2-1, degree(g_N)<=2N, ||grad g_N||_2<=2N sqrt(delta_N), and |grad f_N|^2<=|grad g_N|^2 on B_N^c, so int_(B_N^c)|grad f_N|^2<=4N^2 delta_N
spectral_gap.inner_gradient: L4 Bernstein and Holder give int_(B_N)|grad f_N|^2<=mu(B_N)^(1/2)||grad f_N||_4^2<=C N^2 sqrt(delta_N) when delta_N<=1
spectral_gap.defect_gap: Comparing the gradient floor with the inner-plus-outer upper bound gives alpha^2 eta/4<=4delta_N+C sqrt(delta_N), hence delta_N>=c_(alpha,eta)>0 uniformly in N; the complementary large-delta cases are immediate
spectral_gap.scope_guard: The cutoff-independent gap requires nonvanishing fixed-ratio shell mass of sgn(f_N); it does not apply to merely nonconstant, localized or vanishing-shell signs and does not compute Gaussian weighted capacity
